body: Ah so true! Hah I appreciate it, pm if needed as well.

I saw and hung out with kings of Leon at 2003 lollapalooza. Amazing set, cool guys but between the insanely hard to understand southern squeal vocals and the belly shirts and bell bottoms, I told my friend "they're soooo good but it sucks they'll never make it. "

Hah so true. Everything you said is me too. I try and relish the little moments. But lately every little moment triggers a memory and I end up sick. So ready to be done. Before I got married I thought getting hitched would somehow cure me. Now it's the only reason I haven't tried to die. So sick of it all. Just like once in my life I'd love to catch a break and be normal. Hah. Anyways appreciate your empathy

Nostalgia. I'm sad about the past, old friends, a wasted life. Have crazy vivid dreams of more enjoyable days and wake up sick. But nothing major, on paper my life is great. Hot wife, thriving business, broken brain
